tetra.module.iss_book/core.name: Core
tetra.module.iss_book/core.description: Determines the spell book's tier, native attributes, and spell-slot capacity. Insert a tiered spell book (Iron, Diamond, Archmage, etc.) into this slot.
tetra.module.iss_book/front_cover.name: Spell Book Cover
tetra.module.iss_book/front_cover.descri: The front cover focuses spell power through its material binding.
tetra.module.iss_book/back_cover.name: Spell Book Backing
tetra.module.iss_book/back_cover.descrip: A reinforced back cover that anchors the book's mana reserves.
tetra.module.iss_book/spine.name: Spell Book Spine
tetra.module.iss_book/spine.description: The spine binds pages to cover and shortens spell cooldowns.
tetra.module.iss_book/pages.name: Spell Book Pages
tetra.module.iss_book/pages.description: The pages where glyphs are inscribed; finer pages mean faster cast times.
tetra.module.ars_book/core.name: Core
tetra.module.ars_book/core.description: Determines the tome's tier, native attributes, and spell-slot capacity. Insert a tiered spell book (Novice, Apprentice, Archmage) into this slot.
tetra.module.ars_book/front_cover.name: Tome Cover
tetra.module.ars_book/front_cover.descri: The front cover focuses Ars spell damage through material resonance.
tetra.module.ars_book/back_cover.name: Tome Backing
tetra.module.ars_book/back_cover.descrip: The back cover holds the tome's mana store.
tetra.module.ars_book/spine.name: Tome Spine
tetra.module.ars_book/spine.description: The spine binds the tome and modulates mana regeneration.
tetra.module.ars_book/dye.name: Tome Dye
tetra.module.ars_book/dye.description: A dye applied to the tome's cover for personalization.

tetra.improvement.iss_book_dye.name: Cover Dye

tetra/schematic/iss_book/core.name: Core
tetra/schematic/iss_book/core.descriptio: Sets the spell book's tier and native attributes. Material slot accepts any tiered spellbook from Iron's Spellbooks (Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite, Druidic, Blaze, Evoker, Necronomicon, Dragonskin, Villager, Rotten, Copper).
tetra/schematic/iss_book/front_cover_mai: Forge the front cover. Accepts: skin (leather, rabbit hide, rotten flesh, rotten leather, phantom membrane), metal (iron, gold, manasteel, terrasteel, netherite, etc.), bone, or gem (diamond, ruby, sapphire, etc.).
tetra/schematic/iss_book/front_cover_lin: Apply a fabric, fibre, or skin lining to the front cover.
tetra/schematic/iss_book/front_cover_dye: Apply a vanilla dye to personalize the spell book's front cover. Cosmetic only.
tetra/schematic/iss_book/back_cover_main: Forge the back cover. Accepts: skin (leather, rabbit hide, rotten flesh, rotten leather, phantom membrane), metal (iron, gold, manasteel, terrasteel, netherite, etc.), bone, or gem (diamond, ruby, sapphire, etc.).
tetra/schematic/iss_book/back_cover_lini: Apply a fabric, fibre, or skin lining to the back cover.
tetra/schematic/iss_book/spine.name: Spine
tetra/schematic/iss_book/spine.descripti: Bind the spine of the spell book from metal, skin, or fibre.
tetra/schematic/iss_book/pages.name: Pages
tetra/schematic/iss_book/pages.descripti: Fashion pages from fibre or skin materials.
